</svg>

title: Polaroid Photo Memory
svg:
<svg class="w-full h-full" fill="none" id="svg-frame-36" viewbox="0 0 320 380" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

<text fill="#0F172A" font-family="Plus Jakarta Sans" font-size="13" font-weight="800" text-anchor="middle" x="160" y="300">ALBUM ẢNH KỶ NIỆM 📸</text>
